```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (book*)>
  <!ELEMENT book (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % pub "Publisher">
  <!ENTITY ent "Standard Entity &pub;">
  <?target-pi data="processing-instruction-value"?>
]>
<catalog xmlns="http://example.com/ns" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink" xlink:type="simple">
  <!-- Root level comment before CDATA and entities -->
  <book>&ent;</book>
  <book>
    <![CDATA[
      Unparsed CDATA section containing special chars: <>&"'
      and markup-like text <catalog></catalog>
    ]]>
  </book>
</catalog>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child*)>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY internal "EntityValue">
  <!ENTITY external SYSTEM "nonexistent.ent">
  <?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="transform.xsl"?>
]>
<root xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml" xmlns:m="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML">
  <!-- Comment inside root with XML entities &internal; -->
  <m:child>
    <?pi-target pi-data?>
    <![CDATA[Nested CDATA with entities &internal; inside]]>
  </m:child>
  <child>&external;</child>
</root>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE note [
  <!ELEMENT note (to, from, body)>
  <!ELEMENT to (#PCDATA)>
  <!ELEMENT from (#PCDATA)>
  <!ELEMENT body (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY sig "Author Signature">
  <?custom-pi action="validate" status="pending"?>
]>
<note xmlns="http://xml.org/note" xmlns:custom="http://xml.org/custom">
  <!-- Header comment -->
  <custom:to>Tove</custom:to>
  <custom:from>Jani</custom:from>
  <body>
    <![CDATA[
      Body content wrapped in CDATA.
      Contains XML-like tags <tag> and references &sig;
    ]]>
  </body>
</note>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE inventory [
  <!ELEMENT inventory (item*)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % remoteDTD SYSTEM "http://localhost/dtd.ent">
  <!ENTITY stock "In Stock">
  <?xml-stylesheet type="text/css" href="style.css"?>
]>
<inventory xmlns="http://schemas.example.com/inventory" xmlns:inv="http://schemas.example.com/inventory/v2">
  <!-- Inventory manifest comment -->
  <inv:item status="&stock;">
    <?inv:action refresh?>
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA block containing <inv:item> tags and other noise.
    ]]>
  </inv:item>
</inventory>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE doc [
  <!ELEMENT doc (section*)>
  <!ELEMENT section (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY ref "Reference Value">
  <?xml-log level="debug" mode="verbose"?>
]>
<doc xmlns="urn:doc:base" xmlns:sub="urn:doc:sub">
  <!-- Top-level documentation comment -->
  <sub:section>
    <?sub:pi control="start"?>
    <![CDATA[
      Section CDATA block.
      &ref; inside CDATA is treated literally.
    ]]>
  </sub:section>
</doc>
```
